name: Gothic Fire Tactical Decision Suite
description: Benchmark evaluation dataset for tactical computer opponent decisions in Gothic Fire

parts.text:
Turn: 1
Situation: Commander Torrez is stationed at Castle Khorinis (Sector 14). Treasury: 150 Gold, 40 Food. Current Army: 0 units. Castle fortification protection is 20. Immediate adjacent sectors (11, 25, 26) are neutral. Primary goal: Establish defensive army garrison before exploring outward.
Legal moves: ['RECRUIT_HEAVY_INFANTRY (Score: 85/100, Warlord Synergy, +3 Heavy Infantry)', 'UPGRADE_PROTECTION_14 (Score: 70/100, Fortify Castle Wall)', 'RECRUIT_LIGHT_INFANTRY (Score: 60/100, Basic Defense)', 'UPGRADE_CULTIVATION_14 (Score: 45/100, Boosts Yield)', 'WAIT (Score: 75/100, Garrison Castle Wall, Safe)']
{"chosen_move": "RECRUIT_HEAVY_INFANTRY (Score: 85/100, Warlord Synergy, +3 Heavy Infantry)", "reasoning": "Highest scored action with Warlord synergy establishes vital castle garrison."}

Turn: 12
Situation: Archon Milten commands Onar's Farm (Sector 23) with an army of 10 Mages and 5 Heavy Infantry. Gold: 120, Food: 80. Enemy rival Gorn is advancing through adjacent Sector 22 with 15 Light Infantry. Milten possesses strong Archon synergy boosting Mage combat power. Sector 22 is within striking range.
Legal moves: ['ATTACK_SECTOR_22 (Score: 95/100, Guaranteed Victory 95% Win, Archon Phalanx)', 'RECRUIT_MAGES (Score: 80/100, Archon Synergy, +1 Mage)', 'MOVE_TO_30 (Score: 50/100, Claim Unowned Sector)', 'UPGRADE_PROTECTION_23 (Score: 45/100, Fortify Farm Defense)', 'WAIT (Score: 40/100, Conserve Strength, Safe)']
{"chosen_move": "ATTACK_SECTOR_22 (Score: 95/100, Guaranteed Victory 95% Win, Archon Phalanx)", "reasoning": "Exploit overwhelming Archon Phalanx combat odds to eliminate enemy commander."}

Turn: 6
Situation: Commander Diego commands 30 soldiers with only 10 Food remaining. Upkeep is 30 Food per turn. STARVATION IMMINENT NEXT TURN. Sector holds unharvested 40 Food ready for collection.
Legal moves: ['COLLECT_RESOURCES_14 (Score: 95/100, Harvest Sector Yield +20g +40f, Prevents Starvation!)', 'RECRUIT_LIGHT_INFANTRY (Score: 35/100)', 'WAIT (Score: 30/100)']
{"chosen_move": "COLLECT_RESOURCES_14 (Score: 95/100, Harvest Sector Yield +20g +40f, Prevents Starvation!)", "reasoning": "Harvest food immediately to avert critical army starvation next turn."}
